title: Block-Level Weight-Space Structure Persists Under Post-Training: An Empirical Study Across LLM Families
abstract: arXiv:2609.26147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern LLMs are deployed as families of post-trained variants (base, instruct, chat, code) derived from a shared set of pre-trained weights. We present an empirical study of how post-training transforms weight-space geometry, covering eight configurations across four architecture families (Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1/3.2, Mistral, Gemma-2). We identify a granularity gap: post-training modifies every tensor (zero of 291-339 tensors remain byte-identical, so hash-based deduplication achieves 0% savings), yet preserves block-level structure (mean cosine similarity exceeds 0.99 and relative Frobenius distance stays below 0.13). Post-training therefore acts as a structured perturbation that shifts every parameter while leaving block-level geometry intact. The property is not universal: independently trained specializations (for example, Qwen2.5-Coder) attain cosine similarity around 0.64 with the general base, indicating a disconnected region of weigh

translated_title: 块级权重空间结构在后训练中得以保持：一项跨LLM家族的实证研究
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型通常以从共享的一组预训练权重衍生出的后训练变体家族（基础版、指令版、对话版、代码版）的形式部署。我们对后训练如何改变权重空间几何结构进行了实证研究，涵盖四个架构家族（Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1/3.2、Mistral、Gemma-2）的八种配置。我们发现了一个粒度差距：后训练会修改每一个张量（在291至339个张量中没有任何一个保持字节级一致，因此基于哈希的去重方法无法实现任何存储节省），但同时又保留了块级结构（平均余弦相似度超过0.99，相对Frobenius距离保持在0.13以下）。因此，后训练表现为一种结构化扰动：它移动了每一个参数，却使块级几何结构保持完好。这一性质并非普遍存在：独立训练的专用模型（例如Qwen2.5-Coder）与通用基础模型的余弦相似度仅为0.64左右，表明其位于权重空间中一个不连通的区域。
tldr: 研究发现后训练虽然会修改模型的每一个张量（导致基于哈希的去重完全失效），却基本保持了权重空间的块级几何结构（余弦相似度超过0.99），而独立训练的专用模型则位于权重空间不连通的区域。
